svg.text: Zoom: the minimal faithful irrep 196883 = 47·59·71, and its 8 closest badges by shape
shape distance = symmetric difference of active-prime sets (which polygons are drawn) · ties broken by ℓ¹ of exponents · spokes labelled with d
depth: exponent magnitude → nested concentric polygons (capped at 4, true value shown as ×e) · the anchor's rings 47/59/71 stay bright across every badge
nearest by shape: #0 (dim 1) · #2 · #3 · #5 · #12 · #54 · #55 · #147 — mostly the smallest irreps; #12/#54/#55/#147 contain all three anchor rings
